NIST officially deprecated SHA-1 in 2011, recommending a full migration to SHA-256 or higher. GitHub also deprecated SHA-1 in 2017.

The computational complexity is much higher than MD5 (128-bit output, 32-bit operation). In modern browsers, SHA-256/SHA-512 has hardware-accelerated support (the Web Crypto API uses a native implementation) and can still typically complete calculations on gigabyte files in seconds. From automatic article generation to smart SEO optimization, AI tools not only increase productivity but also open up new possibilities for content creators. ## Advantages of AI-assisted writing ### 1. Improve efficiency AI writing tools can produce a large number of high-quality drafts in a short time, allowing creators to focus on strategic planning and creative thinking. According to statistics, the average productivity of content teams using AI-assisted writing increases by more than 40%. ### 2. Improve SEO performance Modern AI tools can analyze search engine algorithms and provide keyword suggestions, content structure optimization and metadata writing suggestions. This significantly improves the ranking of web content in search results. ### 3. Multilingual content expansion For global enterprises, AI translation and localization tools allow content to quickly adapt to different markets. Not only is it a simple translation, but it can also adjust the tone and wording according to local cultural habits. ## How content creators can adapt to the AI ​​era. Although AI has brought many conveniences, the value of content creators is still irreplaceable. Here are some strategies to adapt: 1. Treat AI as a collaborator rather than a competitor 2. Focus on high-level strategy and creative thinking 3. Develop a unique perspective and voice 4. Master the skills of AI Prompt Engineering 5. Continuously learn and update skills ## SEO Optimization Practical Advice To get the best performance of your content in search engines, follow these principles: - Write high-quality, original content - Target keywords are naturally integrated into the article - Optimize title tags (50-60) characters) - Write an attractive Meta Description (150-160 characters) - Use structured data markup - Ensure that web pages load quickly - Build high-quality external links ## Conclusion Artificial intelligence is not here to replace content creators, but to help us better use our creativity. Embracing AI tools while maintaining unique human insights and emotional connections is the key to winning content creation in the future.
